summary: Verified the Notes app full-screen + edit-modal fix. All 5 review scenarios pass on the preview URL (/apps/iron-rabbit-notes/launch). The full-screen view stays open when the edit icon is clicked, the Edit Note modal correctly overlays on top of it, the Update button applies changes and the full-screen view immediately reflects the updated title (via the useEffect that syncs fullScreenNote with the fresh notes array), Delete closes the full-screen (intentional), and the X close button returns to the accordion list.

issues: Radix a11y warning still present in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}' (non-blocking; carried over from iteration 4).

passed_tests: STEP1-3: Notes migrated and rendered (4 notes); expanded first accordion; clicked Full screen button → [data-testid='fullscreen-note'] became visible with title 'Test #4'.

STEP5-7: Clicked [data-testid='fullscreen-edit-btn'] → 'Edit Note' modal opened AND [data-testid='fullscreen-note'] remained in DOM & visible (previously it closed/shrunk). Screenshot 2 confirms Edit Note modal is layered on top of the still-open full-screen view.

STEP8-12: Edited title in modal to 'TEST_EDITED_895310' and clicked Update. Modal closed, 'Updated!' toast shown, full-screen view stayed open, and its H2 title immediately updated to 'TEST_EDITED_895310' — confirming the useEffect on [notes, fullScreenNote] correctly syncs the fresh note by id/updated_at. Screenshot 1 shows the updated title in the still-open full-screen view with 'Edited: Jul 22, 2026 17:39' in the footer.
STEP13: Clicked [data-testid='fullscreen-close-btn'] (X) → full-screen closed and DOM node removed.
STEP14-15: Reopened full-screen for a note, clicked [data-testid='fullscreen-delete-btn'] → full-screen closed after delete (intentional, per fix).
action_items: (Optional / minor) Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to the Edit Note / Settings DialogContent to silence the Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: FullScreenNote edit button correctly calls only onEdit(note) — the previous onClose() call has been removed (NotesApp.jsx:161), so the full-screen no longer collapses when the edit modal opens.

useEffect at ~line 665 correctly watches [notes, fullScreenNote] and calls setFullScreenNote(fresh) when fresh.updated_at differs, giving instant reflection of edits. It also correctly closes the full-screen view (setFullScreenNote(null)) when the note is deleted from the underlying notes array.
Delete button still calls onClose() before onDelete which is intentional and matches the requirement — a deleted note should not remain full-screen. Verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notes app is at /apps/iron-rabbit-notes/launch. Full-screen selectors: [data-testid='fullscreen-note'], [data-testid='fullscreen-edit-btn'], [data-testid='fullscreen-delete-btn'], [data-testid='fullscreen-close-btn'], [data-testid='fullscreen-share-btn']. To open full-screen: expand first .accordion-note then click button[title='Full screen']. Edit modal Update button: get_by_role('button', name='Update', exact=True). Title input: input[placeholder='Enter title...'].
rca of the issue: Original bug: clicking edit icon inside full-screen view first invoked onClose() (closing the full-screen) before opening the edit modal, so the note appeared to 'shrink back'. Fix applied in NotesApp.jsx:161 — onClick handler now only calls onEdit(note). Additionally, a useEffect at line 665 was added that watches [notes, fullScreenNote] and re-sets fullScreenNote to the fresh note object (matched by id) whenever its updated_at changes; this ensures the still-open full-screen view instantly reflects edits made via the modal. If the note is deleted, the effect also auto-closes the full-screen view by calling setFullScreenNote(null). Verified end-to-end via Playwright on the preview URL.
